info.name: LedgerOne - Accounting (Currency)
info.description:
Accounting module (Currency, Exchange Rate) API collection (Create, Get, Update, Activate, Deactivate, List Currency; Create, Get, List Exchange Rate). Reflects the implementation exactly as shipped in apps/api/src/shared/accounting.

Design note (JWT required, but no X-Tenant-Id validation path for Currency): Currency is platform-owned reference data (00_BUSINESS_RULES.md Ch.7.5, 06_DATABASE_STANDARDS.md MT-005) so its own endpoints declare no X-Tenant-Id requirement — but every /api/v1/accounting/* route, Currency included, still sits behind jwt-auth.middleware.ts (verified live: a Currency request with no Authorization header still 401s with AUTH_MISSING_TOKEN). Exchange Rate is tenant-owned (MT-001) and requires X-Tenant-Id like Financial Year/Fiscal Period; the same current-tenant.middleware.ts rewrite-in-place behavior means a missing X-Tenant-Id header on an Exchange Rate request does NOT itself fail validation (the verified JWT claim overwrites it before this module's schema ever inspects it) — same documented behavior as FinancialYear.postman_collection.json/FiscalPeriod.postman_collection.json, so this collection does not include a dedicated 'missing X-Tenant-Id' failure case for Exchange Rate either.

Design note (repeatable ISO-code generation): Currency's iso_code is globally unique with no deletedAt-composite reuse policy (a deliberate never-reuse decision, accounting.prisma's own Currency model comment) and there is no delete endpoint for Currency at all (Ch.7.5 — not deleted by end users), so repeated Newman runs cannot rely on a prior run's rows being gone. A collection-level pre-request script derives three distinct 3-letter ISO codes from the current timestamp (base26-encoded, full ^[A-Z]{3}$ namespace) once per Newman invocation, making cross-run collisions practically impossible without needing manual cleanup between runs. Test data (Currencies + Exchange Rates created by this collection) is still deleted directly via SQL after a verification pass, matching FinancialYear's/FiscalPeriod's own established cleanup convention (Currency has no HTTP delete path to clean up via the API itself).

Design note (Currency Lifecycle Cleanup folder): the Third Currency is deactivated in the Currency folder and deliberately left Inactive through the entire Exchange Rate folder (so the 'inactive currency' Exchange Rate rejection test has a real fixture to reference) — reactivated only in the final folder, both to exercise the activate endpoint and to avoid leaving a permanently-Inactive row from a normal run.

Run order for a full pass, top to bottom: every Currency request before the Exchange Rate folder; {{primaryCurrencyUuid}}/{{secondCurrencyUuid}}/{{thirdCurrencyUuid}} must all be set (by the three 'Create ... Currency - Success' requests) before any Exchange Rate request runs.
